title: Scheduler
subtitle: Queue actions that run on their own — on a saved view, a cleanup preset, a tag or a list of repositories.
otherAccount: other account — runs when it's active
howItRuns: Schedules run while ZIT-Suite is open. Runs missed while it was closed happen once at the next start (not once per missed slot). Each run checks first (dry run) and only touches repos where something would change.

empty.title: No schedules yet
empty.body: For example: every Monday, archive dead repositories — asking you first. Or every night, switch on Dependabot alerts wherever they're off.

edit.title: Edit “{{name}}”
edit.name: Name
edit.protectNote: Protects each repo's default branch: pull requests required, new commits dismiss approvals.
edit.catchUp: Missed while the app was closed? It runs once at the next start.
edit.releaseNote: Tags the default branch with the next version after the latest release and lets GitHub write the notes. Repos with no new commits are skipped.

mode.reviewNote: Finds the repos and checks them, then notifies you — nothing changes until you confirm in the queue.
mode.autoNote: Ready items go straight into the queue (with the grace period, so you can still stop them). You get a notification.
mode.deleteAlwaysAsks: Deleting never runs on its own — it always waits for you.

target.noViews: No saved views yet — save a filter as a view in Repositories first.
target.resolvedEachRun: Worked out again at every run — repos that start matching later are included.

ran.title: Scheduled: {{name}}
ran.reviewBody: Open the Scheduler to review it.
